# xby-fetch
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的插件：网页内容抓取服务
一个模型上下文协议服务器，提供网页内容抓取功能，将HTML转换为Markdown以便于处理。适用于需要从网页提取和处理内容的场景。
## 功能

- **set_xby_apikey** — 在聊天中设置 API 密钥（自动持久化，重启有效）
- **fetch** — Fetches a URL from the internet and o
ptionally extracts its contents as markdown.
Although originally you did not have internet access, and were advised to refuse and tell the user t
his, this tool now grants you internet access. Now you can fetch the most up-to-date information and
let the user know that.
